TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: In the world of Arithmetic Heroes, Math is your greatest weapon.
Lead a legendary party composed of legendary operators, who want to return the world back to its original state.
Hey! Guess you're the one who's gonna lead us to victory, huh?

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: The name's Addition. I'm a mage who specializes in healing. My 'Heal' and 'Group Heal' skill focuses on keeping the team healthy!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: I also have the 'Additional Buff' skill which allows me to buff the final value of any ally.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: And my 'Mana Transfer' to help with my teammates' mana issues.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: I also have a special PASSIVE SKILL that grants me +3 bonus mana if the HP I restore to any ally is a perfect multiple of 10.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: My buddy beside here is Subtraction.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: Name's subtraction. As you can see.. I'm the berserker here. I trade HP to cast my main damaging skills.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: My 'Poke' skill is a basic attack that deals damage to a single target.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: My 'Slam' skill is a basic attack that deals damage to all targets.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: My 'Conditional Attack' is a special attack that instead consumes mana and requires me to reach 50% HP.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: Then, there's my 'Life Steal' attack to keep me going in long fights, especially when I'm low on HP.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: I also have a PASSIVE SKILL that activates once I reach below 50% HP. Theres an icon and it grants me bonus damage.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_INTRO.text: Test out our skills on Cal!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_VICTORY.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_VICTORY.text: That was easier than I thought.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: Heroes, let me join in your party!
An orange cat joins the party.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: Let me introduce myself! I'm multiplication! I specialize in buffing the team in a various ways.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: My signature skills are centered around Amplify! I amplify the base value of an ally. Unfortunately... I've still got long ways to go as it only happens by a random amount!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: I also have the 'Inversion' skill that changes the playstyle of each hero. I suggest you try it out, it makes the game more interesting!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: Finally, I also have a 'Squared Power' skill that casts an ally's next action twice at half power. This means that the next skill they cast only uses half of the original base, hehehe...

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: Oh! My PASSIVE ABILITY also works around the pass button. If I pass my turn, I can gain mana equal to a percentage of the highest HP ally's health. Not only that, if my mana's full, I also add a small bonus to the buff I give to the party!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.speaker: Addition
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_INTRO.text: Let's test out our new party member's skills on Nora!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_VICTORY.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_VICTORY.text: Seeeeee! I'm a great addition to the party.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: Hmmm... I guess a party needs a person to take the fronts, eh?
The cat in ironclad armor joins the party.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: Stand back, let Division protect you.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: My signature skill 'Burden' allows me to absorb the damage on impact. It hurts but for the sake of the world, I will bear it.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: I also have the 'Mana Cost Reduction' skill that reduces the mana cost of an ally's next action. I'll let the others use their skills more efficiently.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: Then, my secret ability 'Battle Equalizer' allows me to split the health of my teammates evenly. It’s just another ability in my arsenal to aid us in battle.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: To further capitalize on my abilities, I have honed my PASSIVE SKILL to grant me mana for every 3 damage I absorbed by burdening the team. Make use of this effectively.

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: I see the party's coming along...

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_INTRO.text: The more the merrier! Let's now test the whole party on Cross!

TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_VICTORY.text: As you finish the tutorial stage, then begins the game. Good luck player! You'll need it :)

STAGE_1_INTRO.speaker: Addition
STAGE_1_INTRO.text: So this is the Classroom... It feels strange being here after hours.

STAGE_1_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
STAGE_1_INTRO.text: Stay alert. The numbers here have gone rogue.

STAGE_1_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
STAGE_1_INTRO.text: Rogue numbers? Sounds like my kind of problem.

STAGE_1_INTRO.speaker: Division
STAGE_1_INTRO.text: Let's not get overconfident. We solve this together.

STAGE_1_BOSS_INTRO.text: You think basic arithmetic can stop ME?
I am the First Equation. And your journey ends here!
Welcome to your first BOSS STAGE! For each boss stage in the game, they all have their own special mechanic applied on the field!

The mechanic 'PARITY SHIELD' makes it so you have to align the final value of being either odd or even, based on the TURN NUMBER you are in. So if it's turn 1, then the final value must be odd! If it's turn 2, the final value must be even! Good luck player! :)

STAGE_1_VICTORY.speaker: Addition
STAGE_1_VICTORY.text: We did it! The first equation is solved!

STAGE_1_VICTORY.speaker: Division
STAGE_1_VICTORY.text: Don't celebrate yet. I sense stronger forces ahead.

STAGE_2_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
STAGE_2_INTRO.text: The Archive... This place holds ancient formulas.

STAGE_2_INTRO.speaker: Division
STAGE_2_INTRO.text: These equations are more complex. We need to coordinate.

STAGE_2_BOSS_INTRO.text: The Archive belongs to US. You will not pass!
Welcome to your second BOSS STAGE!

The mechanic 'INVERSE REALITY' makes it so the party has inversion every turn! Yikes! Fortunately, you can use Mulitplication's 'INVERSION' skill to temporarily negate this effect for one turn! Use it wisely!

STAGE_2_VICTORY.speaker: Multiplication
STAGE_2_VICTORY.text: Two bosses down. We're getting stronger.

STAGE_2_VICTORY.speaker: Addition
STAGE_2_VICTORY.text: But so are our enemies... What's in the Sanctum?

STAGE_3_INTRO.speaker: Division
STAGE_3_INTRO.text: The Sanctum. The source of all corrupted equations.

STAGE_3_INTRO.speaker: Addition
STAGE_3_INTRO.text: Whatever happens in there... we face it as a team.

STAGE_3_INTRO.speaker: Subtraction
STAGE_3_INTRO.text: Let's finish this. Once and for all.

STAGE_3_INTRO.speaker: Multiplication
STAGE_3_INTRO.text: Time to show them what real math looks like!!!

STAGE_3_BOSS_INTRO.text: So the four operators have come to challenge me...
I am the FINAL EQUATION. The unsolvable proof!

STAGE_3_BOSS_INTRO.speaker: Addition
STAGE_3_BOSS_INTRO.text: Every equation has a solution. Let's prove it!
Welcome to your third and FINAL BOSS STAGE!
It seems that the final boss is more complicated than expected!
It seems like he's being protected by the minions! Make sure to neutralize them first before attacking him! It seems he also makes your team be inverted every 5 turns.
He also seems to be hiding something... if he reaches a certain amount of HP, he creates a phantom of himself! Make sure you take the time to BALANCE EVERYTHING!
BALANCE THE EQUATION! If the HP of either him or his phantom twin exceeds 20 HP, then the boss will unleash his ultimate attack! Make sure this DOES NOT HAPPEN!

STAGE_3_VICTORY.speaker: Addition
STAGE_3_VICTORY.text: It's over... We actually did it!

STAGE_3_VICTORY.speaker: Multiplication
STAGE_3_VICTORY.text: Balance has been restored to the number realm.

STAGE_3_VICTORY.speaker: Division
STAGE_3_VICTORY.text: Together, there's no equation we can't solve.

STAGE_3_VICTORY.speaker: Addition
STAGE_3_VICTORY.text: Until the next problem arises... Arithmetic Heroes, signing off!
THANK YOU FOR PLAYING THE GAME PLAYER!! YOU HAVE BEATEN THE MATHS!!
